title: The Dead Sea Scrolls — Gematria Discernment Companion
publicationLimits: Standard Hebrew gematria is used for declared Hebrew spellings; every result depends on spelling.
Hebrew final letters use their standard values in this companion, not enlarged mispar gadol values.
English Ordinal, Full Reduction, Reverse Ordinal, and Reverse Reduction are modern comparison systems, not ancient Hebrew gematria.
English spaces, punctuation, accents, and hyphens are ignored by the companion's stated method.
Digital roots are modern contemplative reductions and are not presented as ancient Qumran practice.
No surviving Qumran manuscript presents the full modern method used in this companion.
Equal values are prompts for comparison, not proof of authorship, prophecy, reincarnation, bloodline, supernatural rank, or historical identity.
A match may suggest a question; it never settles a historical claim.

hebrewGematria.rule: Sum the declared Hebrew spelling letter by letter using standard Hebrew gematria values; final forms retain standard values in this companion.
hebrewGematria.control: Hebrew spelling first; numerical value second; historical context always.

englishCiphers.normalization: Ignore spaces, punctuation, accents, and hyphens.
englishCiphers.control: Report all four values rather than selecting only a favorable result.

digitalRoots.rule: Repeatedly sum decimal digits until one digit remains.
digitalRoots.historicalStatus: Modern contemplative reduction; not ancient Qumran practice.

evidenceHierarchy.limit: None of these grades establishes supernatural or historical identity.
